hero.headline: Here's what we build.
hero.description: We don't work off a fixed service list. We build software around how your business already works — starting with what's below.

story: We started by building websites. A few clients needed more — a way to track stock, work out pricing, and send bills without doing it all by hand. So we built that too. This page shows what we've actually built, and how we think about the next thing.
statement: We build software that makes your business run smoother, faster, and more organized — built around how you already work.

painPoints.title: If any of this sounds familiar, that's the kind of problem we solve.
items: You're juggling WhatsApp, Excel, and paper just to keep things running.
The same information gets typed into two or three different places.
Only one person really knows how something works — and things stall when they're away.
Your website hasn't changed in years and doesn't look like your business today.
There's no single place to see what's actually happening across the business.
Something only works because someone remembers to follow up.

built.name: Websites
built.tagline: A website built for your business, not a copy-paste template.
built.description: This is where we started, and we still do it — a simple, fast website that actually looks like your business. For a lot of clients, it's also the first step before something bigger.

built.name: Stock & Inventory Tracking
built.tagline: Know what you have and where it is.
built.description: A system that tracks stock as it moves through your business — what's come in, what's been used, and what's left. It started with one manufacturing client, and the same idea works for any business that needs to keep track of stock.

built.name: Alu360
built.tagline: One tool for design, pricing and billing.
built.description: Our first product. It works out what a job needs, turns that into a quote, and creates the bill — all in one place instead of three. Built first for window and door fabricators; the same idea works for any business that quotes and bills for jobs.

capabilities.name: Automating manual work
capabilities.description: If a task only happens because someone remembers to follow up — approvals, reminders, weekly reports — we can build something that does it instead.

capabilities.name: Anything else that runs your business
capabilities.description: If it's not listed above, tell us how you work. If it's still on paper or in a spreadsheet, there's a good chance we can build a better way.

process.title: Coordination
process.description: We start by understanding how you actually work — not by pitching a template.

process.title: Demo
process.description: We show you a working version built around your process, not a generic mockup.

process.title: Trial
process.description: You use it in your real operations before committing to anything.

process.title: Iterate
process.description: We keep refining until it fits the way you actually work — until you're satisfied.

process.title: Stay connected
process.description: We keep asking for feedback after launch. It doesn't end at delivery.

whyUs.title: We don't disappear after launch
whyUs.description: We keep coming back to check in, fix things, and add what's missing.

whyUs.title: We build one thing well, not everything at once
whyUs.description: Every business tracks stock or sends quotes a little differently. We build around how you actually do it.

whyUs.title: We start by listening
whyUs.description: Before we build anything, we sit with how you work today — then show you a demo, let you trial it, and keep improving until it fits.

reach: Working with businesses across Gujarat and Chhattisgarh — from Anand, Vadodara, Jamnagar and Junagadh to Rajkot.
